hypothesis: Outcome-guided synthesis of executable decision trees over structurally different exact joins improves cold native synthesis cost beyond the strongest validation-selected fixed or expert-dispatch program.
claim_boundary: The learner synthesizes control flow and chooses join direction/index construction from an authored grammar. It does not invent unrestricted native code. Recursive evidence requires a separate matched-starting-state improver comparison.
goals: Half the goals are sampled random words; half are selected uniformly from novel composed tables generated by independently seeded random half-bank pairs. Target semantics are deduplicated and targets in the half-bank excluded. Shortfalls retained. This is an attempt to increase semantic diversity, not exhaustive uniform semantic sampling.

timing.metric: cold native process CPU: actual lazy feature/index construction plus complete query batch; common Python semantic-bank generation charged equally in analysis

success: Primary seed 5101 beats validation-selected strongest fixed/expert control by at least 20% geometric cold CPU with paired domain-bootstrap 95% interval excluding parity, no correctness failures, and beats equal-budget random and saved-only controls. All five reruns and costs retained.
meta_experiment: On training/validation only, compare three authored mutation-procedure AST distributions at matched 16-candidate budgets; choose a procedure using validation, freeze it, and compare original vs selected procedure in five full fresh searches on new training/validation seeds and a second untouched final test. This supports only a bounded improver-selection claim, not unrestricted recursive self-improvement.
freeze: Publish protocol, evaluator and selected source hashes before the corresponding final tests. Never tune on final results.
meta_note: If original policy wins procedure selection, the original and selected improvers are identical and share measurements; no recursive improvement can be claimed.
